description: This file defines the DrupalTranslator class, which implements translation functionalities for Drupal, including string translation, pluralization, and locale management, used within Drupal's validation system.

classes.name: DrupalTranslator
classes.description: Implements string translation and pluralization for Drupal, managing locale settings and processing translation parameters.

methods.name: trans
methods.description: Translates a string or returns the TranslatableMarkup if already translated.

methods.name: transChoice
methods.description: Handles pluralization of messages based on a number, supporting singular and plural forms.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the current locale for translations.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the current locale, defaulting to Drupal's current language if not set.

methods.name: processParameters
methods.description: Processes translation parameters, converting safe string objects and Symfony patterns to Drupal patterns.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Provides options for TranslatableMarkup, primarily the language code.
